controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature. The disc itself is unresolved; darkening toward the edge from a published law.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The wind's measured brightness profile is drawn from its record beside the star (source/photometry, new-object --star-limb).. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention. The darkening toward the edge is the power law I(mu) = mu^6.05 whose brightness is half the centre's at the diameter Weigelt et al. (2007), arXiv:astro-ph/0609715 measured for it, 2.33 mas, on a disc that ends at their tenth-brightness diameter, 5.15 mas (VLTI/AMBER K-band continuum at 2.174 um; not a visible band).
